'''James Hall Save You It Wont -so just go run home to Daddy Vader''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[James Hall]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-20469">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20469 Save You It Wont -so just go run home to Daddy Vader], DeckTech (James "Newk" Hall, 6 January 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/20469/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/20469/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016201851/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20469/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[James Hall]]
* '''Published:''' 6 January 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Save You It Wont -so just go run home to Daddy Vader''

== Original post ==

'''Save You It Wont -so just go run home to Daddy Vader'''
* '''Author:''' James "Newk" Hall
* '''Published:''' January 6, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Mind What You Have Learned, with high destiny, easy battles to win and fun to play.

=== Strategy ===

I train to number 6 and set up #5 yo where I get an easy 7. I stop the opponents force drains to give me more time to finish my training.
